newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan central bank auctions six-month bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan central bank auctions six-month bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan auctioned six-month federal bonds worth a total of 125 million rupees in an open market operation on Wednesday.

The bank said bids worth 25 million rupees were accepted for outright sale of the bonds at a maximum cut-off of 16.5 percent, while bids worth 100 million rupees were accepted for five-month repurchase contracts at the same cut-off.

In the last open market operation on January 8, bids worth 50 million rupees were accepted for outright sale of the bonds at a maximum cut-off of 16.5 percent while bids of 200 million rupees were accepted for five-month repo at the same cut-off.
